about: Synthetic report texts for evaluating the leak detectors. Every person, number, plate, address and account is invented. Labels follow the guideline in docs/LEAK_CHECKER.md and mark what a careful reviewer would want the reporter to look at, whether or not the detectors catch it.

guideline.email: Any email address, including obfuscated ones.
guideline.phone: Any phone number in any format, including numbers written in words.
guideline.national-id: Citizenship, national ID, PAN, passport, licence or National Insurance numbers.
guideline.vehicle-plate: Vehicle registration numbers in any script.
guideline.personal-url: Links to personal social media accounts, and @handles.
guideline.street-address: House, flat or plot numbers, numbered street addresses, and full postcodes. Not wards, areas or towns.
guideline.personal-name: Names of individual people in any role, including the people being reported on. Not businesses, temples or places named after people.
guideline.quasi-identifier: First-person details that narrow down the reporter (labelled with the closest rule), plus any exact day-level date or clock time.
